title: Calendar
overview: This guide covers calendar workflows for System Admin.

subtasks.title: Configure Visit Types
subtasks.purpose: Define the appointment types (name, description, duration, colour) that can be booked on the calendar.

steps.title: Open Visit Types
steps.description: Click Calendar in the left sidebar, then choose Visit Type from the Calendar Setting fly-out.

steps.title: Check for Duplicate Type
steps.description: Use the Search box to check whether a similar visit type already exists.

steps.title: Add Visit Type
steps.description: Click + Add Visit Type (top-right).

steps.title: Enter Visit Type Details
steps.description: Enter Practice Name, Visit Type, Visit Type Description, Duration (minutes), Status and pick a Color swatch.

steps.title: Save Visit Type
steps.description: Click Save to add it to the list.

steps.title: Edit or Delete Visit Type
steps.description: Use the row Action icons to edit or delete an existing visit type. Notes Colour drives the appointment block colour on the Calendar view — pick contrasting shades for adjacent visit types. Duration is the default block length; individual bookings can still be resized when scheduling. An empty list shows the “No visit types found” placeholder until the first entry is saved.

subtasks.title: Configure Working Hours (Office Hours)
subtasks.purpose: Set the practice’s bookable office hours for each day of the week within a date range.

steps.title: Open Working Hours
steps.description: Click Calendar → Working Hours.

steps.title: Set Schedule Window
steps.description: Under Office Hours, set the Start Date (required) and optional End Date for the schedule window.

steps.title: Tick Open Days
steps.description: Tick the checkbox next to each day the practice is open (Sun–Sat).

steps.title: Set Start & End Times
steps.description: For each active day, adjust the Start Time and End Time (default 09:00 AM – 05:00 PM).

steps.title: Add Extra Time Block
steps.description: Click the green + in the Action column to add an additional time block (e.g. split shift) on that day.

steps.title: Save Working Hours
steps.description: Click Save to publish the schedule. Notes Days left unchecked are treated as closed — no appointments can be booked on those days. Leaving End Date blank keeps the schedule active indefinitely until it is edited. Overlapping time blocks on the same day are prevented by validation.

subtasks.title: Use the Calendar view
subtasks.purpose: Browse the appointment grid, pick a slot granularity, and view assignments by caregiver.

steps.title: Open Calendar View
steps.description: Click Calendar → Calendar.

steps.title: Navigate Between Months
steps.description: Use the « / » arrows at the top of the month grid to move between months.

steps.title: Select a Date
steps.description: Click any date to load that day’s slot list in the right-hand panel.

steps.title: Change Slot Granularity
steps.description: Change the slot granularity via the dropdown (default 15 Minutes; other options available).

steps.title: Refresh Appointments
steps.description: Click the refresh icon to reload appointments after external changes.

steps.title: Toggle Week/List View
steps.description: Toggle Week / List (top-right) to switch between weekly grid and vertical list layouts.

steps.title: Overlay Caregiver Bookings
steps.description: In the System Caregivers panel, tick one or more caregivers to overlay their bookings on the grid.

steps.title: Clear or Reset Date
steps.description: Click Clear to remove any date filter, or Today to jump back to the current date. Notes If “No working hours available for this day” is shown, revisit 6.8.2 and enable the day or extend the date range. The date shown in the right-hand header (e.g. July 22, 2026) reflects the currently selected calendar cell. Ticking a caregiver adds their name to the visible legend so overlapping appointments can be distinguished by colour. Task 6.9 — Programs
